verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ de bruphihọ kẹ Noa vẹ emọ rọye, ọ da ta kẹ ayen, We vwiẹ ri we bu phihọ, ru wa vọn akpọ na.
verses.text_romanized: oghene de bruphiho ke noa ve emo roye o da ta ke ayen we vwie ri we bu phiho ru wa von akpo na

verses.text_urhobo: Oshọ wẹn kugbe udidi wẹn ko mu eranvwe keranvwe rẹ akpọ na, ji te ọphra kọphra rọ obenu na, emu kemu ejobi ro kpono vwẹ otọ na kugbe erin rẹ ame; mi phi ayen ejobi phihọ obọ wẹn,
verses.text_romanized: osho wen kugbe udidi wen ko mu eranvwe keranvwe re akpo na ji te ophra kophra ro obenu na emu kemu ejobi ro kpono vwe oto na kugbe erin re ame mi phi ayen ejobi phiho obo wen

verses.text_urhobo: emu kemu ejobi rọ yan ro vwo arhọ kọ dia emuọre kẹ wẹ, kirobo Me vwẹ ifọn kẹ wẹ na, Me je kẹ wẹ emu ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: emu kemu ejobi ro yan ro vwo arho ko dia emuore ke we kirobo me vwe ifon ke we na me je ke we emu ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo wọ ria uvwo vẹ arhọ rọye-e, kọye ọbara rọye.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo wo ria uvwo ve arho roye e koye obara roye

verses.text_urhobo: Fiki rẹ ọbara rẹ arhọ wẹn na ke Me ghene nekpẹn rẹ osa rọye, vwẹ obọ rẹ eranvwe keranvwe Me da nekpẹn rọye Etiyin ji te ohwo rẹ akpọ, vwẹ obọ rẹ oniọvo rọye.
verses.text_romanized: fiki re obara re arho wen na ke me ghene nekpen re osa roye vwe obo re eranvwe keranvwe me da nekpen roye etiyin ji te ohwo re akpo vwe obo re oniovo roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ohwo ro sun ọbara rẹ ohwo te otọ, ohwo ọfa ji sun ọbara rọye te otọ, kidie Ọghẹnẹ ma ohwo vwẹ uhoho rọye.
verses.text_romanized: ohwo ro sun obara re ohwo te oto ohwo ofa ji sun obara roye te oto kidie oghene ma ohwo vwe uhoho roye

verses.text_urhobo: Vwọ kẹ ovwan, we vwiẹ ri we bu phihọ, we vwiẹ buebu vwẹ akpọ na ru we bu phihọ.
verses.text_romanized: vwo ke ovwan we vwie ri we bu phiho we vwie buebu vwe akpo na ru we bu phiho

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ Noa vẹ emọ rọye,
verses.text_romanized: etiyin oghene da ta ke noa ve emo roye

verses.text_urhobo: Nighe, ke Me vẹ owẹ cha re ọphọ kugbe uvwiẹ wẹn rọ cha vwẹ obuko wẹn,
verses.text_romanized: nighe ke me ve owe cha re opho kugbe uvwie wen ro cha vwe obuko wen

verses.text_urhobo: kugbe eranvwe keranvwe ekpokpọ re vẹ owẹ gba herọ, uche ri nene uwe nẹ evun rẹ okọ na rhe.
verses.text_romanized: kugbe eranvwe keranvwe ekpokpo re ve owe gba hero uche ri nene uwe ne evun re oko na rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Me vẹ owẹ ke re ọphọ, ne Me gbe cha vwẹ ame rẹ oghwe vwo hwe uvwo ejobi ọfa eyẹ vwọ vwẹ oghwe vwọ ghwọrọ akpọ na ọfa-a.
verses.text_romanized: me ve owe ke re opho ne me gbe cha vwe ame re oghwe vwo hwe uvwo ejobi ofa eye vwo vwe oghwe vwo ghworo akpo na ofa a

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta, Ọnana kọ cha dia oka rọ ọphọ na re Me vẹ owẹ kugbe eranvwe keranvwe rọ herọ re Me mare na cha re, kugbe uvwiẹ rọ cha vwẹ obaro wẹ;
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta onana ko cha dia oka ro opho na re me ve owe kugbe eranvwe keranvwe ro hero re me mare na cha re kugbe uvwie ro cha vwe obaro we

verses.text_urhobo: Me cha vwẹ aphoro mẹ vwo mu vwẹ enu rẹ ikoro na, kọ cha dia oka rẹ ọphọ vwẹ uvwre mẹ kugbe akpọ na.
verses.text_romanized: me cha vwe aphoro me vwo mu vwe enu re ikoro na ko cha dia oka re opho vwe uvwre me kugbe akpo na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ikoro de mu vwẹ enu rẹ akpọ na re a da mrẹ aphoro vwẹ enu rẹ ikoro na,
verses.text_romanized: oke re ikoro de mu vwe enu re akpo na re a da mre aphoro vwe enu re ikoro na

verses.text_urhobo: ke Me karohọ ọphọ rọ herọ vwẹ uvwre mẹ vẹ owẹ kugbe eranvwe keranvwe rọ herọ re Me mare ejobi, ame na gbi che hirhe oma phihọ oghwe rọ ghwọrọ ohwo ọfa-a.
verses.text_romanized: ke me karoho opho ro hero vwe uvwre me ve owe kugbe eranvwe keranvwe ro hero re me mare ejobi ame na gbi che hirhe oma phiho oghwe ro ghworo ohwo ofa a

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ aphoro na da obenu, ki mi no ke Me karohọ ọphọ ri bẹdẹ rọ uvwre rẹ Ọghẹnẹ kugbe eranvwe keranvwe ekpokpọ rọ herọ re Me mare vwẹ akpọ na.
verses.text_romanized: oke re aphoro na da obenu ki mi no ke me karoho opho ri bede ro uvwre re oghene kugbe eranvwe keranvwe ekpokpo ro hero re me mare vwe akpo na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ da ta ki Noa, Ọnana kẹ oka rẹ ọphọ na ri mi vwo mu vwẹ uvwre mẹ kugbe uvwo ejobi rọ enu rẹ akpọ na.
verses.text_romanized: oghene da ta ki noa onana ke oka re opho na ri mi vwo mu vwe uvwre me kugbe uvwo ejobi ro enu re akpo na

verses.text_urhobo: Emeshare ri Noa ri nẹ evun rẹ okọ na rhe da dia Shẹm, Ham, kugbe Jafẹt, Ham kọye ọsẹ ri Kenan.
verses.text_romanized: emeshare ri noa ri ne evun re oko na rhe da dia shem ham kugbe jafet ham koye ose ri kenan

verses.text_urhobo: Enana erha na keye emọ ri Noa; enana erha na keye ri vwiẹ akpọ na soso.
verses.text_romanized: enana erha na keye emo ri noa enana erha na keye ri vwie akpo na soso

verses.text_urhobo: Noa kọye ọghwẹrẹ rẹ ẹsosuọ rọ tu voro otọ na. Ọ da kọn ogba ri vain,
verses.text_romanized: noa koye oghwere re esosuo ro tu voro oto na o da kon ogba ri vain

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da da udi ri vain na, udi de muo, o de shevwerhẹ otọ rẹ utughẹ rọye vẹ ẹbẹba.
verses.text_romanized: o da da udi ri vain na udi de muo o de shevwerhe oto re utughe roye ve ebeba

verses.text_urhobo: Ham, rẹ ọsẹ ri Kenan, da mrẹ ẹba rẹ ọsẹ rọye, o de rhi gbe ikun kẹ iniọvo rọye vwẹ otafe.
verses.text_romanized: ham re ose ri kenan da mre eba re ose roye o de rhi gbe ikun ke iniovo roye vwe otafe

verses.text_urhobo: Shẹm vẹ Jafẹt da reyọ ewun, ayen da vwọ kpahe igabọ, ayen da vwẹ ukuko re rhurhu ẹba rẹ ọsẹ rayen ayen de ku opharo fia, ayen gbe rha mrẹ ẹba rẹ ọsẹ raye-en.
verses.text_romanized: shem ve jafet da reyo ewun ayen da vwo kpahe igabo ayen da vwe ukuko re rhurhu eba re ose rayen ayen de ku opharo fia ayen gbe rha mre eba re ose raye en

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Noa vwo gbunie rhọvwọ rhe o de vughe obo rẹ emọ rọye rẹ itete ivẹ na ru kẹ,
verses.text_romanized: ri noa vwo gbunie rhovwo rhe o de vughe obo re emo roye re itete ive na ru ke

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da ta, Eka ki Kenan, ọviẹn rẹ ọviẹn wọ dia kẹ iniọvo wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta eka ki kenan ovien re ovien wo dia ke iniovo wen

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da je ta, Ọrovwohwo rẹ Ọghẹnẹ mẹ bruba kẹ Shẹm, gbe ji Kenan dia ọviẹn rọye.
verses.text_romanized: o da je ta orovwohwo re oghene me bruba ke shem gbe ji kenan dia ovien roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ hẹre ishamwa ri Jafẹt, e jọ dia itughẹ ri Shẹm, e je Kenan dia ọviẹn rọye.
verses.text_romanized: oghene here ishamwa ri jafet e jo dia itughe ri shem e je kenan dia ovien roye

verses.text_urhobo: Noa da rhoma dia akpọ na ikpe uri gbẹ ujughwrẹ gbẹ ihwe, vwẹ ọke rẹ oghwe na vwo kunu.
verses.text_romanized: noa da rhoma dia akpo na ikpe uri gbe ujughwre gbe ihwe vwe oke re oghwe na vwo kunu

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ ri Noa ejobi da dia ikpe uri ẹne gbẹ ujughwrẹ gbẹ ihwe o de ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: ede re akpo ri noa ejobi da dia ikpe uri ene gbe ujughwre gbe ihwe o de ghwu
